Name: Berachiah, Father of Asaph
Summary: Father of Asaph the singer, son of Shimea.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:39: Father of Asaph the singer, son of Shimea.
LifeLesson: The mention of Berachiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
